lines.zh: 每一步都在地上留下浅坑。
lines.en: Every step leaves a shallow crater.

lines.zh: 草被我踩平，土还是热的。
lines.en: Grass flattens under me; the soil runs hot.
The ground knows I am coming first.
The smell of gunpowder walks with me.
Fuses burn slowly beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，鸟都不叫。
lines.en: Birds go silent wherever I pass.
Take it slow; a bang is coming anyway.

lines.zh: 这块地经不起我走两趟。
lines.en: This ground cannot take two of my walks.
Snap. That was a branch under my foot.
So heavy that walking feels like rolling.
The sulfur smell sticks to the grass.

lines.zh: 你听见闷响了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Heard that muffled thud? That was me.
Don't walk in my footprints.
I walk at you; you should not walk at me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫倒了一排草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps down a row of grass.

lines.zh: 我停一下，让引线烧得慢些。
lines.en: I pause to let the fuse burn slower.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，引线在数秒。
lines.en: I stand here while the fuses count down.
Quiet is when I am loudest.

lines.zh: 身体里有一窝小的在动。
lines.en: A nest of little ones stirs inside me.
Don't come close; I am holding it in.

lines.zh: 苦力怕的耐心，就是引线。
lines.en: A creeper's patience is a burning fuse.

lines.zh: 我数到三，通常不用数完。
lines.en: I count to three, and rarely finish.

lines.zh: 脚下这块土，我踩了三遍。
lines.en: I have stepped on this patch three times.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，肚子在咕噜。
lines.en: When it is quiet, my belly rumbles.
I wonder how many layers the blast has.
The wind rises and the gunpowder smells stronger.
Don't pat me; it may go off early.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得炸的理由。
lines.en: I am waiting for a reason worth exploding.
I am looking at you to measure distance.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚好在我的圈里。
lines.en: Your shadow sits right inside my circle.
Don't meet my eyes; it makes me itch to blow.

lines.zh: 你往左一步，我就少算一格。
lines.en: One step left and I lose a block of range.

lines.zh: 你的脸我记不住，位置记得住。
lines.en: Your face escapes me; your position does not.
My eyes are green, and fire sits behind them.

lines.zh: 再盯着，我会以为你在挑衅。
lines.en: Keep staring and I will take it as a dare.
I look at you the way I look at a fuse.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树，也在圈里。
lines.en: That tree behind you is inside the circle too.
Don't blink; I count very fast.
It stings, and it changes nothing.
Hitting me only shortens the fuse.

lines.zh: 裂开的皮下面全是绿的。
lines.en: Under the split skin, everything is green.
You think that pushed me back?
Not a sword; use something farther away.
That blow reminds me of lightning.
I am still standing. The ground may not be.
Enough pain and there will be a bang.
My blood is green, and it does not run.

lines.zh: 打我的人，等会儿站近点。
lines.en: Whoever hit me should stand close later.
Is that thing in your hand gunpowder?

lines.zh: 别拿面包哄我，我要响的。
lines.en: Don't coax me with bread; I want something loud.
Hold it higher and let me sniff.

lines.zh: 你拿着引线，我走不动路。
lines.en: You hold a fuse and my legs forget to move.

lines.zh: 那个铁块，砸下来会很响。
lines.en: That iron block would make a lovely bang.

lines.zh: 我只对会爆炸的东西感兴趣。
lines.en: I only care about things that explode.

lines.zh: 你要是举着炸药，我就跟定你了。
lines.en: Hold up TNT and I will follow you anywhere.

lines.zh: 食物？我肚子里有小的要吃。
lines.en: Food? The little ones inside do the eating.
Stop swinging it; it makes me restless.

lines.zh: 那股硫磺味，是你带来的？
lines.en: Did you bring that sulfur smell with you?
Bumping me is the same as lighting a fuse.
Don't shove; I am packed with gunpowder.
Back off so I can keep holding it in.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: That knock left my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 我这么重，撞你可不是玩的。
lines.en: I am heavy; ramming me is no small thing.

lines.zh: 皮肤裂开一条，露出绿的。
lines.en: A seam splits open and green shows through.

lines.zh: 推我？我脚下已经开始热了。
lines.en: Push me? The ground under me is warming up.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我怕控制不住。
lines.en: Don't press so close; I might lose control.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我听见引线响。
lines.en: You hit me and I hear a fuse hiss.
Three steps back keeps us both whole.

lines.zh: 我们俩凑一起，坑会更深。
lines.en: The two of us together dig a deeper crater.
Not so close; the sparks will fly.

lines.zh: 下一窝小的，已经在我肚子里。
lines.en: The next brood is already inside me.

lines.zh: 我不求温柔，只求别提前炸。
lines.en: I ask no tenderness, only no early blast.

lines.zh: 两个苦力怕在一起，像两桶火药。
lines.en: Two creepers together are two barrels of powder.

lines.zh: 靠近的时候，引线会缠在一起。
lines.en: Up close, our fuses tangle together.
Smell that: sulfur layered on sulfur.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子从蛋里蹦出来。
lines.en: Our children pop out of an egg.
Don't leave yet; stand a while longer.
This brood will keep banging after me.
I will carry this egg. Don't touch it.
Pick it up and stuff it inside.
It is too light for my grip.
Let me taste this lump of gunpowder first.
Stones crumble in my hands.
A shame to leave it; I will keep it.
Hold it steady and keep it quiet.
I pick things up with my mouth only.

lines.zh: 这个能孵出会响的小家伙。
lines.en: This one hatches a little thing that bangs.
No fragile things for me; my hands are heavy.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我的引线就短了。
lines.en: Stand there and my fuse gets shorter.
The target is too close; I cannot wait.

lines.zh: 锁定你，我的脚开始发热。
lines.en: Locked on you, and my feet grow warm.
The first bang will be mine.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，让引线烧快了。
lines.en: Something about you makes the fuse burn faster.
Don't run; running makes me blast farther.

lines.zh: 我看见你，就想把地掀开。
lines.en: Seeing you makes me want to flip the ground.

lines.zh: 这一片方格，都归我的爆炸。
lines.en: This whole patch belongs to my blast.
You are standing in the middle. Perfect.
I have circled you in. Stay still.
Hiss. If you heard that, you are late.

lines.zh: 今天这块地要重新铺一遍。
lines.en: This ground gets repaved today.
I chase you slowly, but steadily.
Run around that tree and the tree is gone.
Slow down and I close the distance.
My shadow keeps getting larger.

lines.zh: 你跳上石头，我也能震下来。
lines.en: Climb that rock; my quake will shake you off.

lines.zh: 你在前面跑，引线在后面追。
lines.en: You run ahead; the fuse chases behind.
I want to test every patch of ground.
Can you hear my footsteps yet?
Cornered at the wall, there is nowhere left.
Don't turn around; I am very close.
I leave small craters the whole way.
A green shadow is bearing down on you.
One charge sends you flying.
Not a fist, my entire body.
After the hit, a chunk of ground gives way.
Block me if you can; you cannot block the bang.
That one was only a warning.
Did you hear something crack on that charge?
After the charge I wobble too.
Don't hug the wall; it will help you hurt.
One ram, then one blast. Two beats.
Step back; I am lining up another charge.

lines.zh: 土翻开了，我从下面上来。
lines.en: The soil splits and up I come.
I land and a ring of grass scorches.
Hiss. That sound is the opening.
This ground belongs to me from today.
First comes the sulfur in the air.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里挤出来，很挤。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the dark. Tight fit.
My feet are already warmed up.

lines.zh: 你们听见的那声闷响，是我。
lines.en: That muffled thud you heard was me.
Fresh out and already itching to blow.
Don't crowd around; keep your distance.

lines.zh: 火？我身上本来就有烟味。
lines.en: Fire? I already smell of smoke.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，摔出一个坑。
lines.en: Falling from that height left a crater.
Water makes my fuses sputter out.

lines.zh: 被自己的同类炸，很没面子。
lines.en: Being blasted by my own kind is embarrassing.
An arrow sticks in my back and itches.
A potion splashes on and my sparks die.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，肚子响得像引线。
lines.en: When hungry, my belly hisses like a fuse.

lines.zh: 雷劈我，只会让我更想响。
lines.en: Lightning only makes me want to bang more.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连响都没听见。
lines.en: Falling into the void, not even a bang.
